messages:
tess: thinking about a lightweight 'capture flow' for route bookmarks — quick save of filters + model pins for side-by-side compares. less modal friction than full savedview dialog.
sohail: +1. are we talking ephemeral session copies or full saved queries?
anna: need both imo. quick-captures for adhoc compares, explicit saves for teams & ACLs.
kevin: telemetry question — how do we count quick-captures in quota/usage? do they inflate savedview counts?
michael: they shouldn't count as persistent saved_views. but they do generate fetches and should show in per-route telemetry as "console.capture" events.
tess: proposal: capture default = ephemeral (30d TTL or session-only). if user clicks "save permanently" we call saved_views.create with scope param.
sohail: sounds fine. API sketch:
```json
POST /api/v1/saved_views
{
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "model_pin": "redwood/open-7b",
  "ephemeral": true
}
```
kevin: need to be explicit about model pin semantics. if model_pin diverges from route default we snapshot it, and route-level rollouts should still map to preferred variants.
anna: UX: show a small badge "ephemeral" on the UI and a cost preview (tokens + est latency) before capture.
michael: cost preview requires quick token-estimate call. recommend reusing /api/v1/cost_preview?route_id=...&model=...
sohail: also telemetry: track console.capture.start, console.capture.save, console.capture.promote_to_savedview. allow sampling for anonymous orgs.
kevin: one more: permissions — ephemeral captures should be visible only to owner; promote action should enforce ACLs.
tess: rollout plan: feature-flag v1 ephemeral to 10% orgs, monitor console.capture.* rates and savedview.create churn. add alert on >5% increase in savedview creates post-rollout.
deploy-bot: rolled out saved_views.capture_v1 to 10% of orgs in us-west :rocket: 
anna: minor UI note — make capture shortcut keyboard shortcut (c) while in route inspector.
kevin: tiny edgecase: what if capture references private model not accessible to some users after promote? show warning and block promote.
sohail: agree. API should return 409 with reason when promote fails due to model ACL.
tess: ok i'll draft rfc with API contract + telemetry events + rollout gating metrics. pinging @kevin for OWNER on API changes.
kevin: happy to own API. :thumbsup:
michael: putting a note in telemetry backlog to add capture metrics to per-route dashboards.
